scope: Current-client KismetMathLibrary uint8 equality and inequality wrappers, VM regression for selected byte boundaries, and repository IR inventory; not full-card or PvP certification.

capture.method: Read-only machine-code capture. The live class and UFunction owners were checked. No game code was called and no game memory was written.

semantics.compare: The wrappers load two byte operands and execute cmp byte ptr [rsp + 0x40], al.

static_ir_inventory.note: The repository snapshot includes assets outside PvP scope; these counts do not establish current-client reachability or PvP eligibility.

regression.result: All 16 equality and inequality outputs match the captured condition-code contract for zero, high-bit, and 255 boundaries; no VM faults.

limitations: The capture covers valid byte operands and visible wrapper instructions, not malformed UFunction frames or all property flags.
The BotSim test evaluates the local VM and does not call the client executable for differential runtime testing.
Static IR usage does not establish PvP eligibility, reachability, or complete card behavior.
Evidence is valid only when the executable SHA-256 matches the value above.
